text.tspan: MAIN WIRING · one controller at the centre · one conductor per route
Selected controller build: follow each named terminal and match every route ID to the evidence list below.
DOTTED = GUESS / proposed wire; verify before connecting
OPEN = no connection until the missing evidence is obtained
Crossing lines are not junctions. Only named terminal circles are connection points. Repeated controller labels are contact references, not extra physical pins.
Selected machine retrofit · individual contact references

C13-001 · Alternative probe function on shared socket · Pinned source lists an E-stop while planning text also asks for one at the machine. Retain or engineer independent spindle/motion energy inhibition; no firmware-only safe stop is promised. Socket rear-view pin7 is Z-min/probe and pin1 GND; its saved configuration disables Z-min, so a new probe assignment requires firmware and physical fitment checks. Sensor socket pin 7 is shared Z-min/probe: select one function in firmware and wiring. Do not install both Z-min and probe signal routes simultaneously.
